title: mode_hooks compile record (kairos_hook_projector stage 1)
description: Stage 1 DoD-S1-6. Every compilation — success or refusal — produces one record of this shape. Success and refusal are distinguished by the `outcome` field, never by the record's absence (Inv-C4). The record is returned to the caller and is not persisted by the compiler (Inv-8); Stage 2 is what chain-records it (Inv-7).

resolution_path.description: Which case produced this record. `absent` and `empty-document` both yield the well-formed empty artifact and are indistinguishable at the artifact layer; they are told apart here and only here (Inv-D3).

document_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalized input document, or null when the resolution path is `absent`.

binding.description: The document's declared binding to a mode-body revision, copied verbatim. Null when the document declares none.

output.description: Present when outcome is `compiled`; null on refusal.

events.description: Realized ordering, auditable from the record alone without re-reading the source document (Inv-O3).

refusal.description: Present when outcome is `refused`; null otherwise. The category set partitions the non-compilable input space exhaustively (Inv-C3).

compiled_at.description: Wall-clock time of compilation. Metadata, explicitly outside the purity projection of Inv-2.
